typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Processing_Org as string,
		PayerCode as string,
		PayerRole as string,
		settle_date as timestamp,
		payreceive_type as string,
		SettleCurrency as string,
		ReceiverInst_Status as string,
		book_name as string,
		PayerInst as string,
		trade_id as integer,
		event_type as string,
		ReceiverCode as string,
		Legal_Entity_Id as integer,
		transfer_id as integer,
		transfer_status as string,
		ReceiverRole as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_source as string,
		ReceiverInst as string,
		PO_SETTLE_METHOD as string,
		Book_Attr_MO_Email as string,
		Settle_Amount as double,
		Original_Cpty as string,
		netted_transfer as integer,
		transfer_type as string,
		Transfer_Amount as double,
		PayerInst_Status as string,
		value_date as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Processing_Org as string,
		PayerCode as string,
		PayerRole as string,
		settle_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		payreceive_type as string,
		SettleCurrency as string,
		ReceiverInst_Status as string,
		book_name as string,
		PayerInst as string,
		trade_id as integer,
		event_type as string,
		ReceiverCode as string,
		Legal_Entity_Id as integer,
		transfer_id as integer,
		transfer_status as string,
		ReceiverRole as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_source as string,
		ReceiverInst as string,
		PO_SETTLE_METHOD as string,
		Book_Attr_MO_Email as string,
		Settle_Amount as double,
		Original_Cpty as string,
		netted_transfer as integer,
		transfer_type as string,
		Transfer_Amount as double,
		PayerInst_Status as string,
		value_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Processing_Org,
		PayerCode,
		PayerRole,
		settle_date,
		payreceive_type,
		SettleCurrency,
		ReceiverInst_Status,
		book_name,
		PayerInst,
		trade_id,
		event_type,
		ReceiverCode,
		Legal_Entity_Id,
		transfer_id,
		transfer_status,
		ReceiverRole,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_source,
		ReceiverInst,
		PO_SETTLE_METHOD,
		Book_Attr_MO_Email,
		Settle_Amount,
		Original_Cpty,
		netted_transfer,
		transfer_type,
		Transfer_Amount,
		PayerInst_Status,
		value_date),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
